extracted.intended_audience: F31 (NIH Kirschstein-NRSA) fellowship applicants, sponsors, and institutional grant administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and completion of an NIH PHS Fellowship (F31) supplemental/resubmission application including biosketches, training plan, human/animal subject sections, budget, and institutional/sponsor documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch length requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the biographical sketch for each Senior/key person and other significant contributors; follow the required format and keep each biosketch to five pages or fewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch required sections (A–D)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following sections in the biosketch: A. Personal Statement; B. Positions and Honors; C. Contributions to Science; D. Scholastic Performance (education/training table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include education/training (begin with baccalaureate), list degrees, completion dates (MM/YYYY), field of study; in Contributions to Science include key publications and a brief narrative of contributions. Follow the format for each person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) fields
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) requires fields such as Prefix, First Name, Last Name, Position/Title, Organization Name, Department, Address, Country, Phone Number, E-Mail, Credential (e.g., agency login), Project Role (e.g., PD/PI), Degree Type, Degree Year, file attachments (biographical sketch, current & pending support), and other project role categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all required profile fields for each senior/key person; attach biographical sketch and current & pending support files. Use the provided format for each person.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form — required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form must include (numbered items in the application): 2. Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship Training; 3. Specific Aims; 4. Research Strategy; 5. Respective Contributions; 6. Selection of Sponsor and Institution; 7. Progress Report Publication List (RENEWAL); 8. Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research; 9. Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements; 10. Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants; 11. Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training; 12–24. Human Subjects and related protections; 19–21. Vertebrate Animals; 22. Select Agent Research; 23. Resource Sharing Plan; 24. Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources; 25. Human Embryonic Stem Cells; 26–32. Administrative items including Degree Sought, Field of Training, Kirschstein-NRSA support, Concurrent Support, Citizenship, Change of Sponsoring Institution, etc.; Budget Section; Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare, attach, or complete each listed section/file as part of the F31 submission. Many of these items are cross-referenced with other forms (e.g., Research & Related Other Project Information) and must be consistent across forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims and Research Strategy requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims and Research Strategy must be provided (items 3 and 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the Specific Aims (F31_Specific_Aims.pdf) and Research Strategy (F31_Research_Strategy.pdf) files as required. These are core scientific components of the fellowship application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of Sponsor and Institution / Sponsor statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection of Sponsor and Institution and Sponsor/Co-sponsor statements must be provided (items 6 and 9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach documents detailing the sponsor's role, mentoring plan, resources, and commitments (e.g., F1 2016_Janko_Sponsor_Section-jnz.pdf). Sponsor must describe training environment and mentoring commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training is required (item 11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a narrative/file (e.g., Description_Institutional_Environment_F31_jnz.pdf) explaining institutional resources, training opportunities, seminars, career development activities, and the institution's commitment to the fellow's training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR) training
rubrics_metrics.description: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research is a required element (item 8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe planned RCR training, coursework, or certification; attach Responsible_Conduct_Research.pdf or equivalent documentation demonstrating the trainee's RCR plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects disclosure and cross-form consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Are Human Subjects Involved? (Yes/No) must be answered and the response shown here is taken from the Research & Related Other Project Information form and repeated for reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you wish to change the human subjects response, make the change on the Research & Related Other Project Information form; you will not be able to edit the response on the PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form. Include Protection of Human Subjects, Data Safety Monitoring Plan, Inclusion of Women and Minorities, Inclusion of Children as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate animals use and euthanasia requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Are Vertebrate Animals Used? (Yes/No). If vertebrate animals are euthanized, indicate if the method is consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines; if not, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide Vertebrate_Animals.pdf and ensure methods, euthanasia procedures, and justifications adhere to AVMA and institutional animal care guidelines; explicitly state whether euthanasia methods are AVMA-consistent or provide justification otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human embryonic stem cell (hESC) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? (Yes/No). If yes, list registration number(s) of specific cell line(s) or check that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Either provide the registry accession numbers for the specific hESC lines to be used or check the box indicating that one from the registry will be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research / Resource sharing / Authentication plans
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, include Select Agent Research declarations (item 22), Resource Sharing Plan (item 23), and Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources (item 24).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and attach the required plans/documents addressing select agents, data/resources sharing, and authentication/validation of biological and chemical reagents and key resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Tuition, Fees, Stipend, Salary, and Supplementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Section requires details on Tuition and Fees (requested or none), Present Institutional Base Salary (senior fellows), Stipends/Salary during fellowship (Federal Stipend Requested and supplementation from other sources), number of months, and description of other support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the budget tables for each budget year, indicate funds requested for tuition/fees if any, and document stipend requests and any institutional supplementation with months covered and dollar amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree, Field of Training, and Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate Degree Sought During Proposed Award (e.g., PHD), Expected Completion Date (month/year), and Field of Training for the current proposal (e.g., 151 Immunology).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the expected degree completion date and field code; this information is used to verify eligibility and training focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current or prior Kirschstein-NRSA support and concurrent support disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose Current Or Prior Kirschstein-NRSA Support (Yes/No) and identify any applications for concurrent support (item 29–30).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List level, type, start/end dates, and grant numbers of prior NRSA support; disclose concurrent support plans or attach explanatory files if applying for concurrent funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship and eligibility statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate Citizenship status (U.S. Citizen, U.S. Citizen or Non-Citizen National, Non-U.S. Citizen with Permanent or Temporary U.S. Visa) and related eligibility information (item 31).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the appropriate citizenship box and, if a temporary visa holder expecting permanent status by award start, indicate that expectation per the form instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Sponsoring Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, provide the Name of Former Institution and related information for changes of sponsoring institution (item 32).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document institutional changes and provide justification or explanation as required by the application instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix and file attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix files (e.g., mentor statements, institutional letters, sponsor files) and other uploaded PDFs are part of the submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure file names and attachments (e.g., Nico_Contreras_Biosketch_16080a9p.pdf, F31_Research_Strategy.pdf) are included, legible, and conform to NIH file size and format policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities and Other Resources description
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe personal cubicle space, access to BSL-2 shared laboratory space, dedicated tissue culture space, and list available equipment (CO2 incubators, phase and inverted microscopes, spectrophotometers, centrifuges, PCR machines including real time, gel imaging system, BD-Fortessa analyzer, DNA sequencers, ultracentrifuges, tissue culture hoods, freezers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide square footage, adjacency of tissue culture space, and detail major equipment available to support the proposed research; this documents institutional capacity to complete the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flow cytometry data acquisition and analysis reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Flow cytometry analysis: Data acquisition will be performed on a custom-made, four-laser BD Fortessa flow cytometer and analyzed using FlowJo software. Rainbow calibration beads will be run within all experiments to allow for cross comparison of studies over time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State instrument model, analysis software, and explicitly report use of calibration beads for standardization across experiments and longitudinal comparisons to support reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planned effort allocation under the award
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities planned under this award include research 80%, seminars/journal club 10%, conferences/career development 10% (per-year descriptions for Year 1 and Year 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify percent effort dedicated to research and training activities for each project year (e.g., Year 1 and Year 2) to show sufficient protected time for research and career development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training and career development narrative requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship Training and Goals for Fellowship and Training Career must describe prior training, planned activities (journal clubs, seminars, conferences), career goals (postdoctoral training, academic career), and commitments to mentoring/underrepresented-minority development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a coherent narrative linking past training accomplishments, current project independence, planned training activities, mentoring environment, participation in diversity/outreach activities, and how the fellowship will enable career progression.
